landing.heroDesc: Pick a YouTube video in Spanish, French, or English. We add clickable subtitles. Don't know a word? Tap it. Definition, translation, context — instantly. That's how Languni works.
landing.problemH2: Why most language apps leave you stuck.
landing.problem1Desc: Flashcard apps drill vocabulary without context. You memorize words in isolation and forget them within days because your brain has nothing to anchor them to.
landing.problem2Desc: Textbook dialogues feel scripted because they are. Nobody talks like that. Real conversations use slang, idioms, and natural pacing that scripted lessons ignore.
landing.problem3Desc: Content is either too basic to be useful or too advanced to follow. Without proper level matching, you're stuck in a cycle of frustration or boredom.
landing.problem4Desc: Regular subtitles are read-only. You see unknown words fly by and can't pause to look them up without breaking your flow and losing the moment.
landing.solutionText: Languni solves every one of these problems with one simple idea:
landing.solutionHighlight: learn from the videos people actually watch.
landing.feat1Desc: Watch real YouTube videos with synchronized, clickable subtitles. The video pauses when you click a word so you never miss a beat.
landing.feat2Desc: Click any word for definitions, pronunciation, translations, and real example sentences — all without leaving the video.
landing.feat3Desc: Tell us your proficiency during onboarding. We surface trending videos calibrated to challenge you without overwhelming.
landing.feat4Desc: Save words with the context you found them in. Review your collection anytime with full definitions and video references.
landing.pricingSubtitle: No surprises. No hidden fees. Cancel anytime.
landing.footerCta: Ready to learn from real content?
